query: We're putting our embedded Mu Server service on the public internet next week. Lock down HTTPS, h2, request limits, overload, shutdown, and monitoring.
Can you productionize this io.muserver app for Kubernetes? It needs a fixed private port behind an ALB, safe Forwarded handling, readiness drain, and connection metrics.
Our MuServerBuilder uses httpsServer() with no HTTPS config. Replace the test cert, require partner mTLS, and make cert rotation safe without downtime.
mu-server starts returning 503 under load and slow uploads hang around forever; tune the handler executor and protocol timeouts and prove the limits.
Audit how this Mu Server 2.4.1 process handles SIGTERM. We need in-flight requests to drain and the stop boolean is confusing our deploy alert.
Which clients are still on HTTP/1.1 and TLS 1.2 in our Mu Server? Wire safe MuStats, SSLInfo, active connection, and rejection telemetry.
Use mu-acme to create a Let's Encrypt account, solve HTTP-01, renew the certificate automatically, and store the account key.
Add CORS for https://app.example and CSRF protection to the browser forms served by Mu Server.
Configure Murp to proxy /billing to an HTTPS upstream, rewrite the prefix, and turn target timeouts into 504 responses.
Add a new Mu Server GET /orders/{id} handler and implement the database lookup and JSON response.
Upgrade this application from mu-server 2.x to 3.x and fix its JAX-RS provider and URI behavior regressions.
In the mu-server library source, fix the HPACK parser integer overflow and add RFC 9113 conformance tests.
